Class PoolTerm
A type of RollTerm which encloses a pool of multiple inner Rolls which are evaluated jointly.

A dice pool represents a set of Roll expressions which are collectively modified to compute
an effective total across all Rolls in the pool. The final total for the pool is defined as the sum
over kept rolls, relative to any success count or margin.

Example: Keep the highest of the 3 roll expressions

prevent collisions.
